detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

Cortagen

Chemical Information:
  • Amino Acid Sequence: Ala–Glu–Asp–Pro (AEDP)
  • Peptide Length: Tetrapeptide
  • Molecular Formula: C₁₇H₂₇N₅O₈
  • Molecular Weight: ~430.17 g/mol
Structural Note:

Cortagen is a short-chain synthetic peptide. While its amino acid sequence is defined, molecular structure representations may vary depending on ionization state and visualization method. For this reason, a discrete molecular structure diagram is not shown.

Product Description:

Cortagen is a synthetic tetrapeptide composed of L-alanine, L-glutamic acid, L-aspartic acid, and L-proline. It is supplied as a lyophilized powder and is intended for use exclusively in controlled in-vitro laboratory research conducted by qualified professionals.

As a short-chain peptide, Cortagen is commonly utilized in experimental settings focused on peptide structure, stability, and interaction characteristics under controlled conditions.

Research Applications:
  • In-vitro investigation of short regulatory peptide behavior in biochemical assay systems
  • Structural and stability analysis of tetrapeptide sequences
  • Comparative studies involving short peptide analogs in controlled laboratory environments
  • Analytical method development for low-molecular-weight synthetic peptides
Storage and Handling:
  • Store lyophilized powder at −20 °C until use
  • Once reconstituted, store at 2–8 °C and use promptly
  • Maintain aseptic handling techniques to preserve product integrity
Product Specifications:
  • Purity: ≥99% (HPLC Certified)
  • Appearance: Lyophilized white to off-white powder
  • Solubility: Soluble in suitable laboratory agents
Compliance Notice:

Cortagen is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
